text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"Shelter inside a building away from windows; nobody outdoors based on Car (500 lb) stand-off zone.","main_move":"STAY_INSIDE_AWAY_FROM_WINDOWS","main_move_text":"Shelter inside, away from windows and outer walls","where_to_go":"Stay where you are and seek shelter inside a building immediately.","do_now":[{"text":"Seek shelter immediately inside a building away from windows and exterior walls.","advice_ids":["exp.orange_shelter"]},{"text":"Move out of line of sight of the scene.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"text":"Stay upwind, uphill, and upstream from the hazard.","advice_ids":["exp.upwind"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not stay outdoors or gather near windows and doors.","advice_ids":["exp.orange_shelter","exp.secondary"]},{"text":"Do not approach the blast scene or enter the danger area.","advice_ids":["exp.keep_away"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"In a vehicle","text":"Move upwind and get inside a building away from windows.","advice_ids":["exp.orange_shelter","exp.upwind"]},{"situation":"Needing assistance","text":"Seek shelter inside the nearest accessible building away from exterior walls.","advice_ids":["exp.orange_shelter"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"The zone basis comes from official distance tables and there is only one data gap.","unknowns":["Hospital emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Bomb stand-off distances are estimates based on test data; the chart states they do not guarantee safety and that the area near the evacuation distances is still potentially dangerous.","Building distances assume typical US commercial construction; Indian buildings may perform differently."],"valid_while":[]}
